description: Defines the CatalogItem class for the BlazorShared.Models namespace, representing catalog items with properties, validation, and image handling logic.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Model class representing a catalog item with properties for ID, type, brand, name, description, price, and picture data; includes validation and image processing methods.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates a picture filename and Base64 string, checking for presence, size constraints, and valid image extension.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Converts an uploaded file (IFileListEntry) to a Base64 encoded string asynchronously.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is one of the accepted image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
